text:
Alex W: Quick idea — before we roll the new playbook rules, can we run a quick CRM sanity script to flag mismatched healthscore -> onboarding status? Thinking: healthscore < 30 but onboarding_stage = 'launched'.
Maria P: yes please. I've seen ~12 accounts like that last week. Can you share the query?
Alex W: pasted below
```
SELECT id, health_score, onboarding_stage, owner FROM accounts
WHERE (health_score < 30 AND onboarding_stage IN ('launched','live'))
AND last_touch < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
LIMIT 500;
```
Samir: Can we also include renewal_probability and last_successful_meeting? We want to capture renewal risk and missed enablement.
Alex W: good call. I'll add those cols. Also thinking of an automated tag `csops:needs-onboarding-review` when matched.
Jen T: who will own the review? If it's the AE we need a cadence note — auto-create a task in HubSpot? :spiral_calendar:
Maria P: CS Ops can run the script, then assign to regional owners in batches. We should create a playbook action: create task + email template + 1-week follow-up.
Samir: Also, edge case: accounts with strategic hold (hold_status = true) should be excluded. Add a filter.
Alex W: noted. Plan: run script on staging CRM tomorrow 9am, sanity diff in console, then run in prod Friday 2pm if no surprises.
CSBot: @channel Run scheduled: crm-sanity-check script queued for 2026-03-27T09:00:00Z
Jen T: I'll prep the task template and share it here by EOD.
Maria P: I'll own prod execution and AE mapping. tagging + playbook automation done post-prod run.
Alex W: thanks — tagging owners: @Maria P (prod exec), @Jen T (task tpl), @Samir (query tweaks). I'll post results in #customer-success after staging run. :thumbsup:
